description: Declarative manifest of every raw data artifact the Assignment 1 pipeline consumes. src/data/download.py is driven entirely by this file - add a source here, not in the code. All paths are relative to the raw data root (default: data/raw).

huggingface.description: The yjw1029/MIND dataset is gated ('gated: auto' - any logged-in HF account is approved automatically, but you must accept the terms once on the dataset page). Requests need a bearer token.
huggingface.help: Get a read token at https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens, then either run 'huggingface-cli login' or export HF_TOKEN=hf_...

sources.name: MIND-small train
sources.description: MIND-small training split: behaviors.tsv (156,965 impressions, 11/09-11/14/2019), news.tsv (51,282 articles), entity/relation embeddings.
sources.citation: Wu et al., MIND: A Large-scale Dataset for News Recommendation, ACL 2020
sources.license: Microsoft Research License Terms (research use only)

sources.name: MIND-small dev
sources.description: MIND-small dev split: 73,152 impressions on 11/15/2019 with click labels present. Used as the held-out temporal test split.
sources.citation: Wu et al., MIND: A Large-scale Dataset for News Recommendation, ACL 2020
sources.license: Microsoft Research License Terms (research use only)

sources.name: EB-NeRD demo
sources.description: EB-NeRD demo bundle: articles.parquet plus train/ and validation/ (behaviors.parquet + history.parquet). Default working scale for the pipeline.
sources.citation: Kruse et al., EB-NeRD: A Large-Scale Dataset for News Recommendation, RecSys Challenge 2024
sources.license: EB-NeRD terms of use (research use only)

sources.name: EB-NeRD small
sources.description: EB-NeRD small bundle, same layout as demo at roughly 10x the impression volume. Used for the scale-up run.
sources.citation: Kruse et al., EB-NeRD: A Large-Scale Dataset for News Recommendation, RecSys Challenge 2024
sources.license: EB-NeRD terms of use (research use only)

sources.name: Ekstra Bladet word2vec document vectors
sources.description: Pre-trained Danish word2vec document vectors keyed by article_id. This is the semantic-retrieval embedding source for EB-NeRD (Q3), avoiding the need to encode Danish text locally.
sources.license: EB-NeRD terms of use (research use only)

sources.name: EB-NeRD test set (RecSys 2024 leaderboard)
sources.description: Unlabelled test bundle required to produce a scored submission for Codabench competition 2469. Not needed for the validation-only dry run; ~1.6 GB archive plus extracted size, so check disk headroom first.
sources.license: EB-NeRD terms of use (research use only)

sources.name: Google BERT base multilingual cased embeddings
sources.description: Pre-computed multilingual BERT article embeddings for EB-NeRD. Optional ablation against the word2vec vectors in Q3.
sources.license: EB-NeRD terms of use (research use only)

sources.name: Ekstra Bladet contrastive vectors
sources.description: Pre-computed contrastive article embeddings for EB-NeRD. Optional third arm for the embedding ablation.
sources.license: EB-NeRD terms of use (research use only)

sources.name: FacebookAI XLM-RoBERTa base embeddings
sources.description: Pre-computed XLM-RoBERTa article embeddings for EB-NeRD. Optional ablation arm.
sources.license: EB-NeRD terms of use (research use only)

sources.name: MIND-large test
sources.description: Unlabelled MIND-large test split: 2,370,727 impressions over 120,961 articles. This is the split the official MIND leaderboard scores on. The archive wraps its files in a MINDlarge_test/ folder, unlike the MIND-small zips which are flat.
sources.license: Microsoft Research License Terms (research use only)

sources.name: MIND-large train
sources.description: Full MIND-large training split (2.2M impressions). Only for the 10x scale analysis; not required by Part I.
sources.license: Microsoft Research License Terms (research use only)

sources.name: MIND-large dev
sources.description: Full MIND-large dev split. Companion to mind_large_train for the scale analysis.
sources.license: Microsoft Research License Terms (research use only)
